patch_description: Collapse the variational circuit to an exact identity and train only the gain and bias. A single CZ is self-inverse, and the fixed six repetitions apply it an even number of times, so the net ansatz is exactly identity. This directly exposes the dataset-provided averaged Z-Z correlators, which already appear sufficient for perfect classification, while reducing the total trainable parameter count from 8 to the theoretical minimum of 2 readout parameters. It also reduces the gate count from 138 to 6 and avoids circuit-parameter optimization noise, potentially improving convergence and parameter efficiency substantially.
